reasoning: Stalks show distinctive shiny dark brown to black discoloration on the rind with lesions coalescing into large dark blotches and streaks along internodes - the hallmark symptom of anthracnose stalk rot. Distinguished from bacterial stalk rot (which shows water-soaked soft rot at nodes with collapse), Diplodia stalk rot (dry tan stalks with small black pycnidia), charcoal stalk rot (internal shredded pith with microsclerotia), and Physoderma stalk rot (black nodes specifically at first/second node).
